name: utils
title: Class name utility
description: Merges conditional Tailwind CSS classes without conflicts.

name: button
title: Button
description: Displays a button or a link with a set of accessible visual variants.

docs.usage: Use the href prop to render an anchor, or omit it to render a native button.

api.name: variant
api.type: default | destructive | outline | secondary | ghost | link

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that reveal content.

docs.usage: Compose Root, Item, Trigger, and Content. Every item needs a stable value.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An image element with a reliable fallback for representing a user or entity.

docs.usage: Place Image and Fallback inside Root. Always provide descriptive alt text for meaningful images.

name: code
title: Code
description: Syntax-highlighted code display with Svelte support and one-click copying.

docs.usage: Pass the source text, its language, and an optional filename label. The highlighter is shared across every instance.

api.name: language
api.type: svelte | typescript | javascript | json | shellscript | text

name: install
title: Install
description: A persistent package-manager switcher for installation commands.

docs.usage: Pass package-manager command prefixes through values and the shared package or CLI arguments through script. Install joins them with one space and remembers the active manager.

api.name: values
api.type: Array<{ value: string; command: string; label?: string; disabled?: boolean }>

name: holographic
title: Holographic
description: Applies an animated holographic spectrum and shimmer over any content.

docs.usage: Wrap any content and optionally pass CSS color values. Shape and border radius are controlled through class; no radius is applied by default. Empty color arrays use the built-in spectrum, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

name: link-preview
title: Link Preview
description: Lazily displays a linked page in a hover and keyboard-focus preview.

docs.usage: Pass a URL and optional link content. The iframe is created only after hover or keyboard focus opens the preview. Sites may prevent embedding through their security headers.
